name: fw watch with a trailing &: deny bgLong fwWatch
fw watch in the foreground: allow
fw watch behind && and &: the whole list is backgrounded: deny
test run sent to the background with a log: allow (not long-running)
2>&1 and &> are redirects, not background: allow

request.cmd: pnpm vitest run 2>&1 | tail -5; cmd &> out.log

name: & inside quotes is text: allow
until loop with &: deny bgLong loop

request.cmd: until grep -q done out.txt; do sleep 5; done &

name: until loop in the foreground with no bound: deny unboundedLoop

request.cmd: until grep -q done out.txt; do sleep 5; done

name: while loop in the foreground with no bound: deny unboundedLoop
until loop with a counter test: allow

request.cmd: i=0; until [ $i -gt 5 ]; do sleep 5; i=$((i+1)); done

name: until loop with a clock deadline: allow
until loop wrapped in timeout: allow

request.cmd: timeout 60 until grep -q x f; do sleep 1; done

name: for loop backgrounded around fw watch: deny bgLong fwWatch

request.cmd: for f in a b; do pnpm fw watch; done &

name: long sleep with &: deny bgLong longSleep
sleep with a minute suffix behind &&: deny
short sleep with &: allow
sleep over the cap set by caps: deny
dev server with &: deny bgLong server
node server script with &: deny bgLong server
tail -f with &: deny bgLong tail
only the unit before & counts: a later foreground fw watch is allowed
newline continues an and-or list: the backgrounded list is long: deny
comment is ignored: allow
empty command: allow
missing cmd is refused
